info.name: Dooit API — Dummy Import
info.description:
Single-request bulk import: Users → Clients → Branches → Customers (all 7 types) → Transactions.

**Setup**
1. Set the `baseUrl` variable (default `http://localhost:5000`).
2. (Optional) Run **Login** in the Auth folder to populate `{{token}}` — the import endpoint is open by default.
3. Send **Full Import** to seed the entire hierarchy in one shot.
4. Use **Minimal Import** for a quick single-entity smoke test.

variable.description: Base URL of the Dooit API server
JWT Bearer token — set automatically by the Login request
First client _id from the last import response
First branch _id from the last import response
First customer _id from the last import response

exec: console.warn('⚠️  No token in response — check credentials');

request.description:
Full hierarchy import covering all 7 customer types.

**Creates (users auto-generated from each entity's own email + userName):**
- 2 Client users (userType: client, role: admin)
- 4 Branch users (userType: branch, role: user)
- 8 Customer users (userType: customer, found by emailHash or created)
- 2 Clients (Alpha Bank, Beta Financial)
- 4 Branches (2 per client)
- 8 Customers — one of each type:
  - individual × 2, company × 1, partnership × 1
  - trust × 1, government_body × 1, association × 1, cooperative × 1
- 15 Transactions

**Variables auto-saved:** `importedClientId`, `importedBranchId`, `importedCustomerId`
Bare-minimum import (no users block) — 1 Client, 1 Branch, 1 individual Customer, 1 Transaction. Use this to verify the endpoint is up before running the full import.
